{{Quote|Halt. Keep your hands visible at all times. You must cooperate fully with Imperial agents. Loyal citizens have nothing to fear from the Empire.|An Imperial Customs Agent|<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)">{{WEGCite|story=Regina Cayli (adventure)|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Office of Customs''', or '''Imperial Customs'''<ref name="GG6-2">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref> was an agency of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] responsible for ensuring imports and exports that traveled through [[Imperial Space]] were legal and complied with Imperial laws and regulations. Furthermore, Customs also helped deter [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and participate in search and rescue missions.

==Description==
{{Quote|Lieutenant Mien Halloor of the Imperial Customs Office is preparing to approve a certain transaction. But he is distracted by a fiscal crisis in his favorite charity. To free his attention from such petty concerns, I'd like you to deliver this donation.|Daclif Gallamby, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Daclif Gallamby|Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[File:Customs.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Golan III Imperial Customs platform near Zhar]]
The Imperial Office of Customs was an agency of the Imperial Military that monitored exports and imports through the space of the Galactic Empire, also making sure that corresponding taxes and tariffs were collected. In that capacity, Imperial Customs engaged legitimate independent spacers and large-scale freight haulers,<ref name="SotGSaga">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], arms runners, [[Spice/Legends|spice]] traders,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> anyone without proper identification signals and other criminals engaged in the movement and sale of illegal substances. Customs also helped against pirates and participated in search and rescue operations.<ref name="SW:EotECR" />

Customs had to answer to the [[Commerce (department)/Legends|Commerce]] agency of [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]], which collected information about the impact of piracy on Imperial trade.<ref name="TFOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>

[[File:Ghtroc720DumpsCargo-SotG07.png|thumb|right|220px|A [[720 light freighter/Legends|Ghtroc 720 freighter]] dumps its cargo at the sight of Imperial vessels.]]
Imperial Customs worked closely with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and used uniforms that were very similar to those used by the Navy, however both were separate organizations.<ref name="SW:EotECR" />

The agency had its own fleet of light patrol starships.<ref name="PP" /> The most recognizable symbol of Imperial Customs was the [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili Star Drive]] [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Light corvette]], more commonly known as the "Imperial Customs Corvette" because the ship was produced exclusively for the Customs office. Customs tried to keep at least one of these vessels on patrol in every system, and backwater systems could expect a visit at least every three to four weeks.<ref name="SotGSaga" />

Other common vessels used by Imperial Customs were the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] and the [[Guardian-class light cruiser]] (plus its later variant, the [[Guardian 334-class light cruiser]]).<ref name="TFOP" /> A number of old [[PB-950 patrol boat]]s were part of the Imperial Customs force.<ref name="PP" />

The Imperial Office of Customs had a significant number of space stations - such as [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun|Golan III]] defensive platforms - under their control at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These platforms were located on common hyperspace corridors of which were serviced and protected by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Usually there were also stormtroopers ready to help Imperial Customs.<ref name="SW:EotECR" /> An example of a Customs Outpost of this type would be the platform located in the [[Zhar system]].

[[File:Iziz_Imperial_Customs_AoROS.png|thumb|left|250px|An Imperial Customs checkpoint in the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]]]
Customs also ran checkpoints in some starports. The agency had formal control over the local starport authorities, but in practice local officers ignored Imperial Customs agents (a situation that smugglers used to their advantage, as local customs employees were more open to bribery).<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref> The empire maintained a [[Iziz Imperial Customs|customs checkpoint]] in the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="AoROS">"[[Operation: Shadowpoint]]"</ref>

Imperial Office of Customs applied [[holoseal]]s to inspected cargo, these holoseals had a register code that could be read with a special Imperial Customs [[Data Scanner|tag scanner datapad]]. The code contained information about where it was issued while the holoseal was hard to remove or modify. Local customs authorities used similar seals but the imperial holoseal was the best coded. Finally Imperial Customs Inspectors were expected to write cargo information into the Imperial Customs database, but they rarely did.<ref name="PSG" />

==History==
Most Imperial Office of Customs officers were honest, but some of them were so corrupt that even legitimate [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] had fear of being boarded by Customs personnel.<ref name="SotGSaga" />

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Commerce agency of COMPNOR began to draw Imperial Customs personnel and assets into operations to shut down [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] supplies. Many leaders of Imperial Customs disagreed with these actions aimed to draw their resources into the war.<ref name="SW:EotECR" />

[[File:Customs_Blockade_IE.png|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial Customs blockade]]
Inspecting commercial vessels was a duty assigned to Imperial Customs, but the Imperial Navy sometimes helped Customs in lawless sectors where more firepower was required. Sometimes the Navy performed its own checks in order to increase the security of installations such as the stardock in [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="PSG" />

It was considered a class 4 [[Imperial Penal References|infraction]] to tamper with an Imperial Customs holoseal (a 1,000 to 5,000 credits fine, up to one month imprisonment and confiscation of cargo). Under some circumstances more severe class 3 or class 2 infractions applied.<ref name="PSG" />

Some officers applied for transfers between the Navy and Imperial Customs, such as [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] (who spent some time in command of Customs vessels)<ref name="The Hutt Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> and [[Mandus Fouc]] (who saw his transfer to the Navy permanently delayed after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]).<ref name="TSoK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref> [[Dwin Arnae]] was removed from the Navy by his superiors and sent to the Sector Interdiction Office of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], eventually becoming captain of a customs corvette.<ref name="GG6:TF">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

At some point before the Battle of Endor, a [[Battle in the Wroona system|battle]] took place in the outer edges of the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]] when Imperial Customs vessels engaged a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet.<ref name="PSG" />

Imperial Customs was still operating some time after [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The exact name of this organization varies in many sources, it has been called Imperial Customs Office,<ref name="SotGSaga" /> Imperial Customs Bureau,<ref name="PSG" /> and most often just named Imperial Customs and referred to as an agency.<ref name="SW:EotECR" />
